title: GEX Overrated in Market Predictions
text: GEX tells you literally nothing that using a base wall regime tool doesn't and the funny part is you'll see the causal relationship between these. So the left bar is the raw association between GEX and the next day range which is 0.420 and SPX. Then we can control for the trailing realized wall which is 0.260. So it's not like simply wall memory. Then we can control for implied wall and you'll notice that it drops to 0.055. What this means is what I'm doing is isolating different market effects. The strongest effect here by far is implied volatility.
